figurative_meaning_en: Occupying a higher position; superior or higher-up
example_sentences_in_bangla: ঊর্ধ্বতনদের সাথে সমন্বয় করে কাজ করুন।
example_sentences_in_english: You need permission from the higher-up official.
Coordinate with the superiors to get the work done.
note: This term is more of a formal expression than a traditional idiom, commonly used in official and workplace contexts in Bengali.
